text: The authors prove that if the robust mistake sets M(T_i, F) satisfy (c, q)-expansion on (S_i^good, T_i) and the robust non-mistake sets M'(T_i, F) satisfy (c, q)-expansion on (S_i^bad, T_i), then any classifier f with err(f, weak labels|S_i) plus its non-robust mass on T_i below c(1 - q - alpha_i) has true error on the uncovered set T_i at most (1 + alpha_i/(1 - 2 alpha_i)) times its non-robust mass on T_i plus max(q, (err(f, weak labels|S_i) - c alpha_i)/(c(1 - 2 alpha_i))). They state that it recovers the Blum and Mitchell co-training bound with c = 1, q = 0 and no non-robust points.
title: Theorem 4.2: coverage expansion error bound for uncovered points
